title: Checkout API database connection pool exhaustion
content: A previous checkout-api incident showed DatabaseConnectionTimeout errors, high db_connection_pool_usage, increased p95 latency, and elevated error_rate after deployment. Mitigation included reducing request pressure, checking pool configuration, and rolling back the deployment if the configuration change was unsafe.

title: Payment retries amplified downstream timeout
content: Payment retry storms can amplify database and network timeout symptoms. Check retry rate, queue lag, downstream latency, and circuit breaker status before increasing concurrency.
